name: Hai đỉnh núi, một lời hẹn
scene: Two remote immortal mountain peaks facing each other across a wide misty chasm, BALANCED WIDE SIDE VIEW. An ivory-robed woman at LEFT sends a glowing paper crane toward a dark-robed young man at RIGHT; the crane is small at CENTER and a thin dawn light connects the fog between them. Scarlet maple leaves on one peak, pale plum on the other. Muted teal, russet, rose dawn and silver. Separation, longing and hope, no bridge and no giant moon.
